title: The window rule (plain TCP) and the ticket tests (TLS, cells of G14) of the paper on a real link between two machines; RTT made with tc netem on the egress of both NICs
needs: two machines on a cable or switch
status: criteria F1-F3 in results/phase2_predictions.md, fixed on 2026-11-20, before the measurement; the TLS part is evaluated with criteria D1-D5 of G14 (unchanged, fixed on 2026-11-19)
notes: Run preflight_phys.sh first. Never run with the experiments of other machines on the same cable. The server host clock is not fixed (host_tune.sh on only the client host); run host_tune.sh on the server host by hand if you want both fixed.
